knowledge:
- key_parameters: platform=The spatial sequencing platform (e.g., "ST" or "Visium") ;; n.PCs=Number of principal components to retain during PCA (typically 7-15) ;; n.HVGs=Number of highly variable genes to use for PCA (typically 2000) ;; skip.PCA=Logical flag to skip PCA and only add metadata in spatialPreprocess() ;; qs=Sequence of cluster numbers to evaluate in qTune() ;; q=Number of clusters to use in spatialCluster() and spatialEnhance() ;; init.method=Initialization method for clustering (e.g., "mclust") ;; model=Error distribution model, either "t" or "normal" ;; gamma=Spatial smoothing parameter (typically 2) ;; nrep=Number of MCMC iterations (recommend >=10,000 for clustering, >=100,000 for enhancement) ;; burn.in=Number of burn-in iterations for MCMC ;; save.chain=Logical flag to save the MCMC chain to an HDF5 file ;; jitter.scale=Scale parameter for subspot proposals; set to 0 to use adaptive MCMC tuning ;; jitter.prior=Prior for jitter (typically 0.3) ;; nrounds=Number of rounds for xgboost in enhanceFeatures(); set to 0 for automatic tuning
- alternatives: mclust=Used as an initialization method for spatial clustering ;; xgboost=Default model for feature enhancement, with linear and Dirichlet regression available as alternatives via the model argument in enhanceFeatures()
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing spatial transcriptomics datasets (such as 10x Genomics Visium or Spatial Transcriptomics) to perform spatial clustering of spots or to enhance resolution to the subspot level and impute subspot-level gene expression.
- pitfalls: A random seed must be set (set.seed) for reproducible MCMC results ;; Running with too few iterations (e.g., 2,000 instead of the recommended >=10,000 for clustering or >=100,000 for enhancement) can lead to poor convergence ;; The jitter_scale parameter must be tuned (or set to 0 for adaptive MCMC) so that subspot proposal acceptance rates are around 30% (evaluated via mcmcChain(sce, "Ychange") stabilizing to 0.25-0.40) ;; Enhancement of Visium datasets requires pixel coordinates of each spot in the tissue image, which are loaded automatically only if using readVisium() (manual construction requires these coordinates for enhancement)

workflows.name: spatial_clustering_and_resolution_enhancement
workflows.intent: Perform spatial clustering and subspot-level resolution enhancement on spatial transcriptomics data.
input: spaceranger_outs/ (Space Ranger output directory containing spatial/ and filtered_feature_bc_matrix/ subdirectories)
colData.csv (table of column data with array_row and array_col columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Load spatial transcriptomics data using readVisium() or manual SingleCellExperiment construction ;; 2. Preprocess data (log-normalization and PCA) using spatialPreprocess() ;; 3. Tune the number of clusters (q) using qTune() and qPlot() ;; 4. Cluster spots using spatialCluster() ;; 5. Visualize clusters using clusterPlot() ;; 6. Enhance resolution to subspot level using spatialEnhance() ;; 7. Impute subspot-level gene expression using enhanceFeatures() ;; 8. Visualize enhanced clusters and gene expression using clusterPlot() and featurePlot() ;; 9. Access or clean up MCMC chains using mcmcChain() and removeChain()
workflows.code:
sce <- readVisium ( "path/to/spaceranger/outs/" )

library (Matrix)
rowData <- read.csv ( "path/to/rowData.csv" , stringsAsFactors= FALSE )
colData <- read.csv ( "path/to/colData.csv" , stringsAsFactors= FALSE , row.names= 1 )
counts <- read.csv ( "path/to/counts.csv.gz" , row.names= 1 , check.names= F, stringsAsFactors= FALSE ) )
sce <- SingleCellExperiment ( assays= list ( counts= as (counts, "dgCMatrix" )), rowData= rowData, colData= colData)

set.seed ( 102 )
melanoma <- spatialPreprocess (melanoma, platform= "ST" , n.PCs= 7 , n.HVGs= 2000 , log.normalize= TRUE )

melanoma <- qTune (melanoma, qs= seq ( 2 , 10 ), platform= "ST" , d= 7 , cores= 2 )
qPlot (melanoma)

set.seed ( 149 )
melanoma <- spatialCluster (melanoma, q= 4 , platform= "ST" , d= 7 , init.method= "mclust" , model= "t" , gamma= 2 , nrep= 2000 , burn.in= 100 , save.chain= TRUE )

clusterPlot (melanoma)

clusterPlot (melanoma, palette= c ( "purple" , "red" , "blue" , "yellow" ), color= "black" ) + theme_bw () + xlab ( "Column" ) + ylab ( "Row" ) + labs ( fill= "BayesSpace \n cluster" , title= "Spatial clustering of ST_mel1_rep2" )

melanoma.enhanced <- spatialEnhance (melanoma, q= 4 , platform= "ST" , d= 7 , model= "t" , gamma= 2 , jitter.prior= 0.3 , jitter.scale= 0 , nrep= 2000 , burn.in= 100 , save.chain= TRUE , cores= 2 )

clusterPlot (melanoma.enhanced)

markers <- c ( "ENSG00000185664" , "ENSG00000116824" , "ENSG00000177455" , "ENSG00000108821" )
melanoma.enhanced <- enhanceFeatures (melanoma.enhanced, melanoma, feature_names= markers, nrounds= 0 )

featurePlot (melanoma.enhanced, "ENSG00000185664" )

enhanced.plots <- purrr :: map (markers, function (x) featurePlot (melanoma.enhanced, x))
patchwork :: wrap_plots (enhanced.plots, ncol= 2 )

spot.plots <- purrr :: map (markers, function (x) featurePlot (melanoma, x))
patchwork :: wrap_plots ( c (enhanced.plots, spot.plots), ncol= 4 )

chain <- mcmcChain (melanoma)
chain[ 1 : 5 , 1 : 5 ]
